eligibility: Open online hackathon; the detail page does not publish additional age, geography, or affiliation restrictions.
team: No team-size rule is published on the official detail page.
build_window: Registration and development opened 2026-06-29 03:00 WIB. DoraHacks displays the final deadline as 2026-08-15 02:59 WIB (2026-08-14 19:59 UTC).
preexisting_work_policy: Existing projects are explicitly welcome, but must separate the prior baseline, newly built work, Flare integration or port, and why the event-period work is meaningful.
mandatory_technology: A meaningful Flare integration for the selected bounty
permitted_inputs: Existing owned project baseline with disclosure
submission_artifacts: Demo link, video, or working application
Explanation of newly built, ported, integrated, or improved work
Smart contract addresses or deployment details when applicable
demo_constraints: No duration or language limit is published on the official detail page. The local plan targets a truthful 2-3 minute English-captioned demo.
judging_rubric: Flare integration quality: meaningful rather than superficial
Technical execution: working demo and credible, understandable architecture
ip_and_license: No event-specific IP or repository-license clause is published on the official detail page; the repository's existing license and third-party notices must remain intact.
privacy_and_conduct: DoraHacks platform terms, privacy policy, and code of conduct remain applicable
Do not expose wallet private keys or other secrets
disqualifiers: Misrepresenting prior work, deployment, transactions, or Flare integration
